_comment: Input for scripts/make_map.py. ETH buildings are found in OpenStreetMap by their 'ETH <code>' tag; 'fetch' is the box queried (south, west, north, east), the map shows the labelled buildings plus a margin. UZH campuses (UZ, UI, UO): buildings found by OSM's 'UZH-<code>' tag, or named here (buildings: osm ids, or contains: a point inside the outline; ETH campuses take osm ids too, for our own buildings such as SPHH); not_on_map: needed buildings OSM has no outline for, with the reason (written as label only: shown where static/map/pins.json places them). splits: an outline OSM draws for two buildings, cut in two along a line (the building, into, two points of the line and a point on into's side). carve: a building of our own cut out of another's outline along a convex polygon (lat, lon), the other keeping the rest as one outline (SPHZ out of ML). extra_margin_m: [x, y] metres added to the margin, for a campus spread out in one direction.

landmarks._source: Centre of HG's dome, from the roof faces in swisstopo/BFE's solar roof layer (ch.bfe.solarenergie-eignung-daecher)

SPHZ._why: The Student Project House Zentrum is the north-west end of ML's outline (FHK, the old district-heating plant, Clausiusstrasse 16): Raffaele's sketch, 18 November 2026, its east side through ML's corner at the courtyard

SPHH._why: The Student Project House Hönggerberg (data/overrides.json extra_spaces) is in HPZ (John-von-Neumann-Weg 9), drawn as a building of its own

KOL._why: UZH's main building (1914) at Rämistrasse 71, untagged; OSM's outline also has KO2 (Karl-Schmid-Strasse 4, cut off by `splits`) and KOH (one connected complex per UniAbility, data/uzh.json map_buildings)

PLG._why: Plattenstrasse 43, the UB's address for its library in PLG

KUM._why: Künstlergasse 15a (UniAbility's address for KUM), OSM's 'Gartenpavillon im Stockargut' (1740)

KOL._why: OSM's one outline for KOL and KO2 (relation/123300); KO2 is the north-west wing with the courtyard, cut where Raffaele drew the line on 17 November 2026; its courtyard is drawn as part of it (Raffaele)

Y63._why: Strickhofstrasse 37 and 35, untagged in OSM, next to Y63's tagged outline (Strickhofstrasse 39): the UB Study Center Irchel West takes up all three

not_on_map.Y03: untagged in OSM (UniAbility: part of Y01, which isn't tagged either); its rooms are still listed
not_on_map.Y04: untagged in OSM (UniAbility: part of Y01, which isn't tagged either); its rooms are still listed
not_on_map.Y16: untagged in OSM (UniAbility: part of Y01, which isn't tagged either); its rooms are still listed
not_on_map.Y05: Cafeteria Atrium's building (in its basement), untagged in OSM (Campus Irchel plan 2022)

AFL._why: Affolternstrasse 56 (Cityport), the UB's address for its libraries in AFL

AND._why: Andreasstrasse 15, the UB's address for its libraries in AND

BIN._why: around OSM's point 'Universität Zürich, Oerlikon (BIN)' (UZH-BIN, Binzmühlestrasse 14)

BIM._why: around OSM's address point Binzmühlestrasse 11, the UB's address for its library in BIM
